Rashi on Keritot 8b:10:1.english: There are two here - For "leper" [tzarua] implies [that] both male and female become impure through leprous marks.

Rashi on Keritot 8b:11:1.hebrew: ה"ג א"כ מה ת"ל איש לענין של מטה - דלטהרת טומאת נגעים א"א, שהרי נאמר והצרוע:
Rashi on Keritot 8b:11:1.english: This is how we read [the text]: If so, why does the verse state “man,” [applying it] to the matter [stated] later - For [applying it] to the purification of the impurity of [leprous] marks is impossible, since it is stated: “And the leper.”

Rashi on Keritot 8b:11:2.hebrew: איש - דכתיב במקרא העליון, לענין מקרא התחתון, שפריעה ופרימה כתובה באחרונה, לומר לך: איש פורע ופורם:
Rashi on Keritot 8b:11:2.english: Man - [The word "man,"] which is written in the earlier verse, [is applied] to the matter of the later verse, for letting the hair grow wild and rending [garments] are written at the end, to tell you: a man lets his hair grow wild and rends [his garments].

Rashi on Keritot 8b:12:1.hebrew: עיקר טומאתן חלוקה - זה בראיות ובימים, וזו בימים ולא בראיות:
Rashi on Keritot 8b:12:1.english: The essence of their impurity is distinct - This one [the zav, becomes impure] through sightings and through days, and that one [the zava] through days and not through sightings.

Rashi on Keritot 8b:12:2.hebrew: כגריס - דזהו שיעור נגע, כחצי פול:
Rashi on Keritot 8b:12:2.english: Like a split bean - For this is the measure of a leprous mark, [which is] like half a bean.

Rashi on Keritot 8b:14:1.hebrew: סוף סוף נזיר - מ"ט לא תני, הא לאישתרויי הוא: ומשני, ההוא לאו לאשתרויי בקדשים אלא ביין דחולין הוא, וכי קחשיב, כפרה דמעכבא שום אכילה דקדשים:
Rashi on Keritot 8b:14:1.english: Ultimately, a nazirite - What is the reason [the Tanna] does not teach [him]? Behold, [his offering] is to permit [him]. And [the Gemara] answers: That [offering] is not to permit [him to partake] of sacrifices, rather it is [to permit him] in non-sacred wine; and when [the Tanna] counts [those who lack atonement], [he counts] an atonement that prevents some eating of sacrifices.

Rashi on Keritot 8b:16:1.hebrew: גר מעוכב לאכול בקדשים - דאפילו לרבנן סבירא להו כר"א בן יעקב דאמר לאישתרויי הוא דמייתי. והא דלא תני ליה, משום דלא מיקרי מחוסר כפרה:
Rashi on Keritot 8b:16:1.english: A convert is precluded from partaking of sacrificial [meat] - For even according to the Rabbis, they hold like Rabbi Eliezer ben Ya'akov, who says that [a convert] brings [his offering] in order to be permitted [to partake of sacrificial meat]. And the reason [the Tanna] does not teach him [in the Mishnah] is because he is not called "one lacking atonement."

Rashi on Keritot 8b:16:2.english: [If] he brought one perida - One young bird [in the] morning.

Rashi on Keritot 8b:16:3.hebrew: אוכל בקדשים לערב - ובלבד שיביא השניה, כדאמרינן לקמן: להביא פרידה אחת א"א:
Rashi on Keritot 8b:16:3.english: He may partake of sacrificial [meat] in the evening - Provided that he brings the second [bird], as we say later: it is impossible to bring [only] one young bird.

Rashi on Keritot 8b:16:4.hebrew: כאן שתיהן עולות - כדאמרן לקמן בגמ' (כריתות ט.) מדור המדבר:
Rashi on Keritot 8b:16:4.english: Here, both of them [are] burnt offerings - As we say later in the Gemara (Keritot 9a), [derived] from the generation of the wilderness.

Rashi on Keritot 8b:17:1.english: He brought his obligatory [offering] from an animal - [i.e.,] one burnt offering, he has fulfilled [his obligation].

Rashi on Keritot 8b:17:2.hebrew: עולה ושלמים - לאו דוקא, אלא משום דבעי למיתני מנחה ושלמים לא יצא:
Rashi on Keritot 8b:17:2.english: A burnt offering and a peace offering - Not specifically [both], rather because [the Tanna] wanted to teach: "a meal offering and a peace offering — he has not fulfilled [his obligation]."

Rashi on Keritot 8b:18:1.english: Just as you [brought] a burnt offering and a peace offering - As it is written (Exodus 24:5): “And he sent the young men of the children of Israel,” etc.

Rashi on Keritot 8b:19:1.english: It should not be enough with it - until he brings a peace offering.

Rashi on Keritot 8b:21:1.hebrew: שכולו לה' - שאין כהן נהנה ממנו, דבעולת בהמה איכא עורה לכהנים, אבל עולת העוף ליכא מידי:
Rashi on Keritot 8b:21:1.english: That is entirely for the Lord - For a priest does not benefit from it, as with an animal burnt offering its hide belongs to the priests, whereas [with] a bird burnt offering there is nothing [for them].

Rashi on Keritot 8b:2:1.hebrew: ה' אשמות תלויין [כו'] חוששין לפשיעה - אם לא הצריכוה לומר "על האחרונה אני מביאה", תהא סוברת שנפטרה בקרבן זה ולא יהו השאר עליה חובה, ותפשע ולא תביאם. וכי מצרכת לה לומר "על האחרונה אני מביאה", ידעה דהשאר עליה חובה; אבל על הספק, שאין השאר עליה חובה, לא מזקקינן לה לומר "על האחרונה אני מביאה":
Rashi on Keritot 8b:2:1.english: Five provisional guilt offerings [etc.] we are concerned for negligence - If they did not require her to say, "I am bringing [it] for the last one," she would think that she has been exempted by this offering and that the rest are not obligatory upon her, and she would be negligent and not bring them. And when you require her to say, "I am bringing [it] for the last one," she knows that the rest are obligatory upon her; however, regarding [an offering brought for] a doubt, where the rest are not obligatory upon her, we do not require her to say, "I am bringing [it] for the last one."

Rashi on Keritot 8b:2:2.hebrew: ורבי עקיבא לא חייש לפשיעה - ואני שמעתי: "חוששין לפשיעה" — שמא תפשע ולא תביא אפילו קרבן אחד, ותאכל זבחים בטומאת הגוף. וקשיא לי בגוה טובא: חדא, אפשר היא מתיא קרבנה, ומשום דלא מצרכת לה לומר "על האחרונה", ליחוש שמא תחזור בה?! ועוד, אי חיישת להכי, כל שכן דעל הספק היא מקילה, ואמאי לא מצרכת לה לומר "על האחרונה"? ליחוש שמא תחזור בה ולא תביאנו, ואכלה בקדשים בספק טומאת הגוף:
Rashi on Keritot 8b:2:2.english: And Rabbi Akiva is not concerned for negligence - And I have heard [the explanation]: "[We] are concerned for negligence" — lest she be negligent and not bring even one offering, and [thereby] eat sacrifices in a state of bodily impurity. And this is very difficult for me: First, is it possible [that] she is bringing her offering, and [merely] because you do not require her to say "for the last one," we should be concerned lest she retract?! And furthermore, if you are concerned for this, all the more so is she lenient regarding a doubtful [obligation], so why do you not require her [in that case] to say "for the last one"? Let us be concerned lest she retract and not bring it, and [thus] eat consecrated food in a state of doubtful bodily impurity.

Rashi on Keritot 8b:4:1.hebrew: ארבעה מחוסרי כפרה - מביאין חטאת, ולא על חטא, אלא לאכול בקדשים:
Rashi on Keritot 8b:4:1.english: Four [who] lack atonement - [They] bring a sin-offering, and not for a sin, but rather to eat of sacrificial [meat].

Rashi on Keritot 8b:6:1.hebrew: עד שיזרוק עליו הדם - דבעי איתויי קרבן, כדמפרש לקמיה:
Rashi on Keritot 8b:6:1.english: Until [the priest] sprinkles the blood upon him - For he must bring an offering, as [the Gemara] explains further on.

Rashi on Keritot 8b:6:2.hebrew: ונזיר ליינו ולתגלחתו ולטומאתו - ונזיר מחוסר כפרה, שכל זמן שלא כיפר, אסור ביין ובתגלחת ולטמא למתים:
Rashi on Keritot 8b:6:2.english: And a nazirite, with regard to his wine, and his haircutting, and his impurity - And a nazirite [is] lacking atonement, for as long as he has not achieved atonement, he is forbidden [from] wine, and [from] haircutting, and to become impure through the dead.

Rashi on Keritot 8b:7:1.english: That he counts them as two - That he counts a zav and a zava as two of those who lack atonement.

Rashi on Keritot 8b:8:1.english: From his flesh - From the strength of his organ and from the force of his passion.

Rashi on Keritot 8b:8:2.hebrew: זבה מטמאה באונס - כדאמרינן בפרק בנות כותים (נדה דף לו:): ״וכי יזוב זוב דמה״ (ויקרא ט״ו:כ״ה) — הרי אונס אמור:
Rashi on Keritot 8b:8:2.english: A zava becomes impure [through] an accidental [discharge] - As we say in the chapter [entitled] Benot Kutim (Niddah 36b): “And if a flow of her blood flows” (Leviticus 15:25) — behold, an accidental [discharge] is stated [here].

Rashi on Keritot 8b:8:3.hebrew: ומטמא בראיות - אם ראה ג' ביום אחד:
Rashi on Keritot 8b:8:3.english: And becomes impure through sightings - If he saw three [sightings] in one day.

Rashi on Keritot 8b:8:4.hebrew: כבימים - אם ראה ג' ימים רצופין, כדמפרש בב"ק בפרק ב' (דף כד.). זבה לא מטמאה אלא בימים:
Rashi on Keritot 8b:8:4.english: Like by days - If he saw [discharge for] three consecutive days, as is explained in Bava Kamma in the second chapter (24a). A zava only becomes impure through days.
